reviewRequired.note: Source treats each rock as having one fixed Mohs hardness, although rocks can contain minerals with different hardnesses.
Supplied ranges cannot be imposed as exact observations; use evidence-based comparative hardness.
Sediment grain-size chart is applied to rocks of different origins; interpretation needs teacher moderation.
Original table/photographs preserved; simplified fixed rock-property claims require moderation.
Original geological map is an accompanying source file. Cultural map is referenced externally, not embedded; provide verified resource links rather than reproducing a newly sourced copyrighted map.
Use reliable museum/community sources and accurate cultural attribution.
Part2 cover says10 but explicit4+2+4+2 allocations sum12; draft and final phase retained together to avoid inflating repeated response counts.
